name: Ragi Tofu Vegetable Uttapam
ingredients: ½ cup plain unsweetened soy yogurt
steps: Whisk ragi flour, rice flour, soy yogurt, water, cumin and salt into a thick batter. Rest 8 minutes.
Fold in crumbled tofu. Adjust batter so it spreads slowly but does not run.
Heat a non-stick tawa over medium-low and brush with a little oil.
Pour batter into two small thick pancakes. Top with onion, tomato and coriander; press toppings lightly.
Cover and cook 3–4 minutes, flip carefully and cook another 2–3 minutes until centre is set.
note: Vegan and egg-free. This is an instant batter adaptation; texture differs from fermented rice-urad uttapam.
